name: Kubota Castle
description: Kubota Castle was the seat of the Satake domain in Akita from 1604. The castle itself was never given a keep; its stone walls, gates and moats survive in Senshu Park, with the Honmaru residence site preserved.
notes: Senshu Park is free to enter; the Akita City Kubota Castle Omoya (main-hall reconstruction) reopens periodically for exhibitions (fee varies).

ja.name: 久保田城
ja.description: 1604年から佐竹氏が治めた久保田城。天守を持たない設計で、石垣・堀・門跡が千秋公園に残ります。
ja.notes: 千秋公園は無料。久保田城御物頭御番所は江戸期の遺構です。
